name: mentura
title: Mentura
note: Mentura is Naive's first adapter, as Vercel is for Next.js (Z-4): it runs the framework's record contract over vendor sources (GitHub), receives systems of record's change notifications (webhooks) and holds the kits. It is verified when it passes the framework's tests: the connector contract suite (naive-framework/knowledge/connectors/suite.mjs) and the router over a GitHub source, both run by platform/connectors/eval.mjs, and the platform's tests of the framework hooks it implements. Its verify paths are relative to this file's folder.
